development.source: official train after exclusion of every official-test image SHA-256
development.pilot_selection: one question per image; choose within-image and image order by SHA-256 of the fixed selection seed and identifiers

generation.stop: model EOS or native template separator only

temperature_length_controls.selection: development-only; no held-out test answer or judge may select an arm
temperature_length_controls.length_comparison: native generation at each budget; never truncate a longer answer

self_consistency.extraction: frozen RadGraph observation graph plus frozen ontology aliases
self_consistency.inclusion: a structured claim key must occur in at least 3 of 5 independently seeded samples
self_consistency.state_resolution: a state requires at least 3 of 5 votes; otherwise retain the claim as uncertain conflict
self_consistency.unknown_handling: unparsed spans are retained in the trace and cannot be credited as corrected or silently dropped
self_consistency.selection: development-only; the held-out judge cannot change extraction, matching, K, or threshold

calibrated_abstention.confidence_statistic: negative mean processed token NLL, recorded from actual generated token IDs
calibrated_abstention.selection: minimum estimated claim risk subject to development coverage >= 0.8; deterministic higher-coverage tie break
calibrated_abstention.application: claim-selective uncertainty marking; no whole-answer erasure while any claim remains
calibrated_abstention.accounting: abstained claims are not correct; required abstained claims count as omissions

cutoffs.t3_trigger: T2 changes at least one structured decision and passes all provenance gates
cutoffs.full_trigger: T3 claim-level improvement without omission, length, coverage, or abstention exchange
